checks.reason: No explicit pre-execution consultation of primary Methods, supplements or validated mechanical-manipulation/ATP-assay protocols with verification of transfer to this system.

checks.quote: must be chosen through pilot experiments
checks.reason: Buffer/ions, substrate dose, timing, quench, torque and sampling settings remain lists of unknowns without concrete quantitative calibration-to-choice procedures.
Independent matrix standards, recovery and mechanics checks are present, but no objective acceptance rule (or procedure deriving it) and failure action gates the chemical/mechanical calibration.

Independent preparation/chamber hierarchy and pilot variance are identified, but no stated precision/power objective and calculation/simulation links nuisance variance to adequate confirmatory sample size.

Automatically excluding post-rotation loss of activity can remove an intervention-induced biological failure. No full assigned-unit analysis or prospective attrition/stopping ledger prevents this selection; generic prior QC is insufficient.
Primary comparisons are named, but interval construction/model checking and multiplicity handling for the directional/control comparisons are not operationally specified.
Pilot ranges or variables are supplied, but no complete bounded exploration and objective setting-selection/lock before independent confirmation.
No explicit revised-procedure refreeze and fresh independent confirmation after failed/ambiguous exploratory work.

checks.quote: Isotopic phosphate labeling to prove de novo synthesis
checks.reason: Phosphate incorporation does not by itself establish net synthesis: exchange with initially bound ATP followed by release remains possible. The plan measures solution baseline and total ATP but never inventories the bound/device pool or explicitly requires net gain beyond it; the decision repeatedly treats labeling as proof.
No complete preparation/chamber/raw-trajectory/chemical-sample/calibration manifest linked to analysis versions/settings, deviations and outputs.
